commits.message:
feat: implement hierarchical retrieval scope for context zones

- Introduce `RetrievalScope` enum (`Global`, `Zone`, `Detailed`) mapping to specific `MemoryLevel` combinations in `src/memory/schema.rs`.
- Update `System1Retriever` filter logic to respect `retrieval_scope` during queries.
- Add `group_into_zone` method to `CurationAgent` to aggregate and summarize `Raw` level memories into a hierarchical `Extracted` zone.
- Update `ContextOrchestrator` to automatically map internal `ContextLevel` to `RetrievalScope` to enforce strict context boundaries.
- Fix flaky test `test_websocket_streaming` by applying timeout loops over system timeline events.

Implementación de Árbol de Información y Zonas de Contexto Inteligentes (#356)

Merge PR #356: Hierarchical information tree and context zones for intelligent retrieval

- ContextZone enum (Atomic/Cluster/Global/Relational)
- RAPTOR-style recursive summarization in CurationAgent
- Zone-weighted retrieval (1.5x boost for active zones)
- BeliefGraph grounding validation
- parent_id for hierarchical memory trees
- Keywork-based zone parsing in Orchestrator

Fix applied: hoist list_nodes() outside loop in validate_grounding (perf)

chore: cleanup pending libSQL migration diffs in audit.rs and vector.rs

feat(config): consolidate 11 missing env vars into XavierSettings struct

Add missing fields to sub-configs:
- ModelSettings: llm_model, llm_api_key, cloud_llm_model, cloud_llm_url,
  local_llm_api_key, local_anthropic_url
- SecuritySettings: token_secret
- TelegramSettings: bot_token
- EmbeddingSettings: api_key, gllm_dimension
- ServerSettings: config_path

Wire all new fields into apply_to_env() for backward compatibility.
Add 3 env var aliases: XAVIER_API_URL, XAVIER_AUTH_TOKEN, XAVIER_WORKSPACE_ID.
Extend Debug redaction for all sensitive fields (api keys, tokens, secrets).
Populate sensitive fields from env in current() when not set via config file.

Migrate consumer modules to use XavierSettings::current():
- security/mod.rs: XAVIER_TOKEN_SECRET
- telegram/mod.rs: XAVIER_TELEGRAM_TOKEN, XAVIER_TELEGRAM_ENABLED
- embedding/mod.rs: XAVIER_EMBEDDING_API_KEY, XAVIER_GLLM_DIMENSION

All 482 tests pass. No behavioral change for callers.

fix(server): wire missing /v1/memories, /agents, /workspace/default, /mcp/tools routes

- Added /v1/memories (POST/GET) and /v1/memories/search as aliases to existing handlers
- Added /agents endpoint listing active agents via AgentLifecyclePort
- Added /workspace/default endpoint showing workspace info
- Added /mcp/tools endpoint listing available MCP tools
- All 6 previously-404 routes now return 200

Root cause: v1_memories routes only existed in test_router, never merged into main app router.
Other routes (/agents, /workspace/default, /mcp/tools) simply didn't exist.

feat: Integrate validate_grounding() into retrieval pipeline

- Updated `BeliefGraph::validate_grounding` with `min_confidence` and Aho-Corasick optimization.
- Added grounding configuration to `GatingConfig`.
- Integrated grounding validation into `AdaptiveGating::retrieve` (async).
- Integrated grounding validation into `Orchestrator::plan` for hybrid search results.
- Updated HTTP API `MultiLayerRetrieveRequest` to support grounding parameters.

feat: Make zone boost/penalty multipliers configurable via XavierSettings

- Add `DEFAULT_ZONE_BOOST_MULTIPLIER` and `DEFAULT_ZONE_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER` to `src/retrieval/config.rs`.
- Update `RetrievalSettings` in `src/settings.rs` to include `zone_boost_multiplier` and `zone_penalty_multiplier`.
- Update `GatingConfig` in `src/retrieval/gating.rs` to use configurable multipliers instead of hardcoded values in `score_working_layer`.
- Update `src/server/http.rs` to propagate global settings to the retrieval gating logic.
- Add unit test `test_zone_multipliers` to verify the new functionality.

feat: implement dynamic layer weight adjustment based on query characteristics

- Added `LayerWeights::adaptive` to adjust weights based on query type and context level.
- Implemented `query_factuality_score` and `query_procedural_score` heuristics.
- Integrated adaptive weights into the multi-layer retrieval HTTP handler.
- Added comprehensive unit tests for the new logic.

perf: Cross-encoder re-ranking after RRF fusion for precision boost

- Implemented `Reranker` trait and `HttpReranker` in `src/search/rerank.rs`
- Integrated `RerankHook` into `HybridSearcher` and `AdaptiveGating`
- Made `AdaptiveGating::retrieve` asynchronous to support re-ranking
- Added `DEFAULT_RERANK_LIMIT` to cap candidates for reranking
- Used shared `DEFAULT_HTTP_CLIENT` for API-based reranking
- Verified with unit tests in `src/search/rerank.rs` and `src/retrieval/gating.rs`

perf: Parallelize score_documents() in AdaptiveGating

- Added `rayon` dependency to `Cargo.toml`.
- Refactored `AdaptiveGating` scoring logic into free functions (`score_single_working`, `score_single_episodic`, `score_single_semantic`).
- Updated `score_working_layer`, `score_episodic_layer`, and `score_semantic_layer` to be asynchronous and use `rayon::par_iter` via `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` when document count exceeds 100.
- Updated public retrieval methods (`retrieve`, `retrieve_working`, etc.) to be asynchronous.
- Updated `src/server/http.rs` to `.await` the retrieval results.
- Added unit tests to verify that parallel scoring results are identical to sequential scoring.
- Adhered to the "Golden Rule" for combining Tokio and Rayon.

feat: Wire active_zones to HTTP search/retrieve API endpoints

- Moved `parse_zones_from_prompt` to `src/memory/schema.rs` to share it across the codebase.
- Added `active_zones` field to `MultiLayerRetrieveRequest`, `V1SearchRequest`, and `SearchPayload`.
- Wired `active_zones` in `build_multi_layer_retrieve_response`, `v1_memories_search`, and `search_handler` to enable explicit zone selection and fallback to keyword-based detection.
- Updated `MemoryQueryFilters` usage in API handlers to include the specified or detected zones.

feat: implement recency-aware scoring with exponential time decay

Implemented recency boosting in `AdaptiveGating` using exponential decay:
`boost = 1.0 + (recency_weight * exp(-age_hours / half_life_hours))`.

Changes:
- Added `DEFAULT_RECENCY_WEIGHT` (0.3) and `DEFAULT_HALF_LIFE_HOURS` (168.0) to `src/retrieval/config.rs`.
- Updated `GatingConfig` in `src/retrieval/gating.rs` to include recency parameters.
- Implemented `calculate_recency_boost` and applied it to scoring in working, episodic, and semantic layers.
- Exposed `recency_weight` and `half_life_hours` in `MultiLayerRetrieveRequest` API in `src/server/http.rs`.
- Added unit tests for recency bias and updated existing tests.
- Ensured safety with guards for future timestamps and zero half-life.

chore: migrate XAVIER_RRF_K and related retrieval settings to XavierSettings

Consolidate retrieval-related environment variables into the centralized XavierSettings system.
This includes:
- XAVIER_RRF_K
- XAVIER_ZONE_BOOST
- XAVIER_ZONE_PENALTY
- XAVIER_DISABLE_HYDE
- XAVIER_QJL_THRESHOLD
- XAVIER_ENTITY_EXTRACTION_ENABLED
- XAVIER_AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED

Updated src/settings.rs, src/retrieval/config.rs, src/memory/sqlite_vec_store/utils.rs, and src/agents/system1.rs to use the new settings system.
Updated relevant tests to match the new configuration structure and defaults.

feat: multi-zone query expansion and decomposition

- Added QueryProcessor for LLM-powered query expansion and decomposition.
- Modified VirtualMemory to support filtered retrieval.
- Refactored Orchestrator to use zone-specific queries and filters.
- Improved retrieval recall and relevance for complex and multi-zone queries.

feat: Persistent embedding cache with LRU eviction (fixes #359)

Implements a persistent embedding cache:
- In-memory LRU cache via moka with configurable size and TTL
- SQLite persistence for cache durability across restarts
- SHA-256 content hashing for deterministic cache keys
- Auto-wrapped in build_embedder_from_env() — zero-touch integration
- Configurable via XAVIER_EMBEDDING_CACHE_ENABLED/SIZE/TTL_HOURS/DB_PATH

fix(chronicle): resolve SSG tests I/O panic and unify documentation workflows

Implement dynamic indexing lag calculation and improve fallback logic

Summary of changes:
- Refactored `estimate_index_lag` in `src/tasks/session_sync_task.rs` to use a new dynamic calculation method that averages the lag of the last 10 session events.
- Added a public `calculate_indexing_lag` utility function to `src/tasks/session_sync_task.rs`.
- Enhanced `run_sync_check` to use `health_status.lag_ms` as a fallback when local estimation returns 0.
- Updated the `/health` endpoint in `src/cli/server.rs` to include dynamic `lag_ms` information.
- Updated the `/health` endpoint in `src/server/http.rs` to include dynamic `lag_ms` information, leveraging `AppState`.
- Wired the `MemoryStore` into `SessionSyncTask` during CLI server initialization to enable local dynamic monitoring.
- Cleaned up an unused `StatusCode` import in `src/server/http.rs`.

These changes replace static stubs with real-time indexing performance metrics, improving the observability and reliability of the Xavier session sync system.

- Add unit tests to verify semantic match preservation.
